tasks.label: Build poryaaaa-rs CLAP debug bundle
tasks.command: cargo build --manifest-path packages/poryaaaa/plugin/Cargo.toml && rm -rf packages/poryaaaa/plugin/target/debug/poryaaaa-rs.clap && mkdir -p packages/poryaaaa/plugin/target/debug/poryaaaa-rs.clap/Contents/MacOS && cp packages/poryaaaa/plugin/target/debug/libporyaaaa_clap_plugin.dylib packages/poryaaaa/plugin/target/debug/poryaaaa-rs.clap/Contents/MacOS/poryaaaa-rs && cp packages/poryaaaa/plugin/Info.plist packages/poryaaaa/plugin/target/debug/poryaaaa-rs.clap/Contents/Info.plist && plutil -replace CFBundleExecutable -string poryaaaa-rs packages/poryaaaa/plugin/target/debug/poryaaaa-rs.clap/Contents/Info.plist && plutil -replace CFBundleIdentifier -string com.sp3cker.poryaaaa-rs packages/poryaaaa/plugin/target/debug/poryaaaa-rs.clap/Contents/Info.plist
